As Sealed Air Corp New (Put) (SEE) Market Valuation Declined, Shareholder Holowesko Partners LTD Lowered by $69.48 Million Its Holding
May 3, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Holowesko Partners Ltd decreased its stake in Sealed Air Corp New (Put) (SEE) by 54.64% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Holowesko Partners Ltd sold 1.42M shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The hedge fund held 1.18M shares of the major chemicals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $58.03M, down from 2.60M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Holowesko Partners Ltd who had been investing in Sealed Air Corp New (Put) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $7.31 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.48% or $0.21 during the last trading session, reaching $43.92. About 2.65M shares traded or 20.67% up from the average. Sealed Air Corporation (NYSE:SEE) has declined 3.17% since May 3, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.72% the S&P500.
Holowesko Partners Ltd, which manages about $4.09 billion and $1.58 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Qualcomm Inc (NASDAQ:QCOM) by 608,900 shares to 650,000 shares, valued at $41.61 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 140,500 shares in the quarter, for a total of 412,500 shares, and has risen its stake in Jd Com Inc (NASDAQ:JD). Sealed Air Corporation (NYSE:SEE) Ratings Coverage
Among 9 analysts covering Sealed Air ( NYSE:SEE ), 3 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 33% are positive. Sealed Air had 10 analyst reports since November 9, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Hold” rating by KeyBanc Capital Markets given on Friday, February 9. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Friday, February 9 by Bank of America. The firm earned “Equal-Weight” rating on Thursday, November 9 by Barclays Capital. Citigroup maintained the stock with “Neutral” rating in Friday, February 9 report. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, November 9 by RBC Capital Markets. The stock has “Neutral” rating by JP Morgan on Monday, February 12. SunTrust downgraded the shares of SEE in report on Wednesday, January 31 to “Hold” rating. The stock of Sealed Air Corporation (NYSE:SEE) earned “Hold” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Thursday, January 25. The firm has “Buy” rating by Vertical Research given on Monday, February 12. Barclays Capital upgraded the stock to “Overweight” rating in Friday, December 15 report.
